correctness.rationale: Degtyarev proves |O_h(N_285)|=2880, T=[6,0,20], and surjectivity to the discriminant-form automorphism group. Primitive K3-lattice gluing gives q_N=-q_T. Direct finite enumeration gives |O(q_T)|=8; O^+(T)={±I} has discriminant image of order 2. Hence the Hodge-compatible inverse image has order (2880/8)*2=720. Global Torelli and the complete polarization identify it with the projective stabilizer. The packaged verifier independently reproduces the finite discriminant calculation.
